title: Rest Beside Still Waters
story:
A little girl had a very busy week at school.

She had assignments to finish, activities to attend, and many things on her mind.

By the end of the week, she felt tired and wished she could simply stop for a while.

One Saturday morning, her father took her to a quiet place near a small lake.

They sat beneath the trees and listened to the gentle sound of the water.

There was no rushing.

No deadlines.

No noise.

After a while, the girl felt peaceful again.

Sometimes our lives become just as busy and noisy.

We keep moving from one responsibility to another and forget that our Shepherd wants us to rest.

God does not only lead us toward our responsibilities; He also leads us toward places of peace and restoration.

When our hearts are tired, we can come to Him.

He knows when we need to slow down, be refreshed, and remember that we are safely in His care.

Just as a shepherd leads his sheep to green pastures and still waters, God lovingly leads us into His peace.
life_lesson: God knows when you are tired and leads you toward rest, peace, and renewal. You can trust Him to care for your every need.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being my Shepherd and caring for every part of my life.

When I am tired, anxious, or overwhelmed, lead me beside Your still waters.

Help me to slow down and rest in Your presence.

Refresh my heart and give me the peace that only You can provide.

Teach me to trust Your guidance and follow You wherever You lead.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What is making your heart tired or restless today?

Are you making enough time to rest in God's presence?

How can you allow God to lead you into His peace today?
verse: I will give you rest in green pastures and lead you to still waters.
